steps.body: Experimental probability (from trials) doesn't always exactly match theoretical probability (from counting outcomes) — but with enough trials, it tends to get close.

choices.feedback: Yes — 12 out of 60 simplifies to 1/5, close to but not exactly the theoretical 1/6.
1/6 is the THEORETICAL probability. The experimental result here (12 out of 60) is 1/5.
